info.title: TheAuth API
info.description: The Auth OS for AI Agents. Identity, permissions, delegation, and audit for the agentic era. Generated from the route table of createTheAuthHandler.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Only agents owned by this user

post.summary: Check whether an agent may perform an action (403 when denied)

403.description: Decision made, the call is not allowed. The body is the same result as on success.

post.summary: Check an action using the agent bearer token (401 bad token, 403 denied)

401.description: Decision made, the call is not allowed. The body is the same result as on success.

403.description: Decision made, the call is not allowed. The body is the same result as on success.

post.summary: Delegate permissions from one agent to another

400.description: Invalid input or a delegation rule failed

get.summary: List delegation chains of an agent (id is the agent id)

delete.summary: Revoke a delegation chain (id is the chain id)

parameters.name: userId

parameters.name: events

parameters.name: cursor

parameters.name: paged
parameters.description: Return { entries, nextCursor } instead of an array

get.summary: Authorization endpoint (redirects to login or the client)

302.description: Redirect to the login page or back to the client

grant_type.description: authorization_code, refresh_token, client_credentials or an RFC 8693 or RFC 7523 grant

redirect_uri.description: Redirect URI used at the authorization endpoint

post.summary: Explain an authorization decision without recording it

DecisionCode.description: Machine-readable outcome of an authorization decision. Branch on this, not on reason.

resource.description: Resource pattern, for example mcp:github:* or tool:file_read

actions.description: Allowed actions: read, write, execute, delete, or *

token.description: Agent token. The plaintext value is returned only by create and rotate, empty otherwise.

score.description: 0 to 1, closeness of the grant to the request

arguments.description: JSON text with secret-looking keys redacted, cut at 2 KB

act.description: RFC 8693 actor claim: sub and client_id of the actor, with act nested for earlier hops

BearerAuth.description: A signed-in user session, or the principal your authenticate hook resolves

ClientBasic.description: OAuth client credentials. client_secret_post and private_key_jwt are also accepted in the form body.
